falsification_conditions.condition: BTC/USD closes above $73,500 on any daily candle
falsification_conditions.what_it_would_mean: A breakout above the August 2024 local high would invalidate the bottom_2024_aug pattern match, which requires price to remain below that resistance level. It would signal continuation of the prior uptrend rather than a bottoming phase.

falsification_conditions.condition: Funding rate on Binance BTC perpetual exceeds 0.05% for 3 consecutive 8-hour intervals
falsification_conditions.what_it_would_mean: Sustained positive funding above this threshold indicates aggressive leveraged longs entering, which contradicts the HOLD signal and bottoming thesis that expects capitulation and low speculative interest before a reversal.

falsification_conditions.condition: BTC spot ETF daily net outflow exceeds $500 million on any single day
falsification_conditions.what_it_would_mean: A massive institutional exodus of this magnitude would suggest structural distribution rather than accumulation, invalidating the bottom_2024_aug pattern which requires institutional inflows to stabilize price and confirm a floor.

doctrine: If you can't list what would prove your call wrong, you don't have a real call.
